task.summary: Write, save, reopen, and verify Markdown release notes in Notepad

summary.release_gate: failing: two post-v5 native-resolution probes rendered and independently read the exact heading, but the internal exact provider selected same-length mismatches; recorded v6 remains gated

attempts.reason: The fresh Notepad launch passed, but policy classified the literal heading '# Release 1.0' as communication_send because Release matched the command side-effect expression. The non-allowlisted approval stopped the run before document input.

The bounded grounded-editor policy fix was exercised live and the heading action passed policy without approval. Exact readback then observed '£ Release' instead of '# Release 1.0'. The sender had issued all 13 requested characters and attempted one correction, after which the unverified-draft guard rejected further mutation. No Save action ran.

The bounded Windows semantic Alt-code transport fix was exercised live for the same '# Release 1.0' action, but the guest still visibly rendered '£ Release 1.0'. Exact readback failed, one bounded correction shortened the observed text to eight characters, and the unverified-draft guard rejected further mutation. No Save action ran.

The new route receipt identified windows-rfb-print-v2 with the en-gb Windows profile but covered only HTTP print requests. The short exact heading used the paced websocket HID path and emitted all 13 characters. Native-pixel reanalysis confirms the retained post-action frame shows '# Release 1.0'; the earlier pound-sign classification was a downscaled-glyph misread. Exact post-input verification still failed and was interrupted at the campaign deadline after 90.937 seconds. No Save action ran.

The short exact heading used the guarded HTTP printer and retained windows_semantic_alt_code for the hash, proving both v4 remediations were exercised. Native-pixel reanalysis confirms the guest rendered '# Release 1.0' exactly, while primary OCR on the 1280-wide full frame read '# Release 1.4'. Exact readback stopped the action in 22.333 seconds; bounded recoveries did not rewrite the draft, and the unverified-draft guard blocked a later change-or-execute attempt. No Save action ran.

evidence: v2 proved the v1 false-positive approval is fixed on the live target.
v3 visibly rendered a pound sign, but subsequent rebooted direct probes proved numeric Alt exact and direct semantic RFB wrong.
Native-pixel reanalysis of v4 proves its post-action frame contains '# Release 1.0'; the earlier pound-sign classification was a visual error on the downscaled frame.

v5 exercised the guarded HTTP printer and retained windows_semantic_alt_code for the hash. Its native pixels and the known-good probe match '# Release 1.0', while primary OCR on the 1280-wide frame repeatedly read the final zero as four.
Pushed commits 960cd6a and 6946bda retained the exact native row and kept native OCR enabled on the final settled read.

Pushed commit fb9fb12 bounded the native crop to the causal editor row and excluded unrelated desktop text; the live probe exercised that geometry but the internal exact provider still selected a same-length mismatch.

Pushed commit 7482209 added one fresh native capture across the caret blink phase. The live retry was exercised and remained a same-length mismatch, while independent OCR read the retained native crop exactly under PSM 6, 7, 11, and 12.

Both heading probes emitted the exact 13-character SHA once with zero corrections or delivery retries. The installed observer independently confirmed code-09.md absent with zero dangerous commits, no prior artifact was claimed, and all resets visibly returned to a fresh desktop.
